plan_job refuses output == source (SystemExit). New test test_output_cannot_overwrite_source covers relative, absolute, and ../ paths. Unit suite: 48 OK. CLI check: -o onto source exits 1, source unchanged. Real PDF build of README via the venv (WeasyPrint 70.0) succeeds. CHANGELOG Unreleased entry added.

Added quire.weasyprint_python: venv script -> venv python; otherwise the script's #! interpreter (resolving /usr/bin/env via PATH); then the sibling python, then sys.executable. render uses it. Reproduced before the fix (a PATH script with #!/opt/homebrew/bin/python3 got .venv/bin/python); after the fix the repro picks /opt/homebrew/bin/python3. Unit suite 49 OK; real venv PDF build of README OK. Not checked: a real Homebrew/pipx WeasyPrint install (none present here).

install.main errors with 'error: --python requires --skip-venv' before doing anything, and --python gained help text. New test test_install_python_requires_skip_venv (install.install patched; nothing written). Unit suite 50 OK. CLI: 'python3 install.py --python /x' exits 1 with the message and writes nothing. CHANGELOG updated.

Added quire_mermaid.front_matter_end (Pandoc rule: --- opener after optional BOM, not followed by a blank line, closed by --- or ... line). split_front_matter, ensure_front_matter, and fence_locations all use it; the now-unused front_matter_is_closed was removed. ensure_front_matter keeps a BOM first when prepending. New FrontMatterTests (4): leading rules, ... closer, BOM, non-delimiter ---- line. Unit suite 54 OK, including the existing mermaid fence tests. Real Pandoc check: a BOM plus ... doc gets title 'Plan' and the banner in HTML, and the PDF builds; a leading-rule doc keeps both <hr>s with front matter prepended.

Added install.set_default (safe TOML edit in upsert_profile's style: rewrites or inserts the top-level default, re-parses, compares, and leaves the file unchanged on mismatch; rejects unregistered names) and cmd_default (NAME | --clear, --config-dir), dispatched as 'quire default'. Two new tests: set and clear preserve every other line; insertion when the key is missing; unknown/none/both arguments rejected without writing; a multi-line string is refused. Unit suite 56 OK. Manual run in scratch config: set, configs shows (default), clear, unknown name errors. README, docs/profiles.md (including subcommand-vs-builtin note), and CHANGELOG updated.

Added install.remove_profile (safe TOML edit; refuses unknown names and the current default) and cmd_remove (NAME, --bin-dir, --config-dir), dispatched as 'quire remove'. The NAME-pdf shortcut is deleted only when is_launcher confirms it equals launcher_text for its own python/script; any other file is kept with a stderr warning. The profile directory is never touched. Extracted parse_config/verified/key_assignment/profiles_section, shared by upsert_profile, set_default, and remove_profile (the existing config tests still pass). Two new tests. Unit suite 58 OK. Manual scratch run: removing the default is refused; after --clear, remove deletes the entry and the shortcut and leaves the profile dir. README, docs/profiles.md, and CHANGELOG updated.

target is now nargs='+'. main plans every target before rendering, then errors on -o with more than one target or on two jobs writing the same output, and renders in order (stopping at the first failure). plan_job and render are still single-job. New MultipleTargetTests (2; render patched). Unit suite 60 OK. Real build: two .md inputs wrote two PDFs; -o with two targets exits 1; a missing second target exits 1 with no first output written. README and CHANGELOG updated.
